identity_check: Gi bout, so the kit is unambiguous: Bruno Fernandes Rocha = BLUE gi, white belt (scoreboard 'BRUNO ROCHA / CIA PAULISTA BJJ'); Rafael Silverio da Fonseca = BLACK gi, white belt ('RAFAEL SILVERIO DA FONSECA / SAO PAULO FC JIU JITSU'). Bound to bodies without the name order: at t=379 the referee raises the BLACK-gi athlete's arm and at t=382 the broadcast prints 'VENCEDOR / RAFAEL SILVERIO DA FONSECA' over that same frame, while the scoreboard reads 0 x 9. Every point in the bout is scored by the black-gi athlete, matching the side of the board that reaches 9.
notes: Division banner (t=6, 720p): 'QUARTAS-FINAL / FAIXA BRANCA / MASTER 2 / MEIO-PESADO', 5:00 match. Clock is 05:00 and PAUSED at t=26/28 and 05:00 RUNNING at t=30 -> bout_start = 30, which is exactly what the reading claimed. 00:04 at t=336, 00:00 at t=340 -> time expires at t~340 (306s of video for 300s of clock, i.e. ~10s of stoppage, seen around t=80-95). Final: Bruno 0 pts / 0 vantagens, Rafael 9 pts / 1 vantagem. Scoreboard read at 720p: Rafael's vantagem lands between t=90 and t=120; his points go 0 -> 2 between t=126 and 130, 2 -> 4 between 284 and 288, 4 -> 7 between 288 and 292, 7 -> 9 between 296 and 300. Every kept ts is snapped onto that clock, which is why five of the six moved. Kept 6 of 7 events read.

log.gemini: Single Leg Takedown / Bruno Rocha / takedown / false
log.verdict: CONCORDANT on the action, kept with the label generalised
log.kept_as: Takedown / Bruno Fernandes Rocha / takedown / false @ts 76

log.verdict: CONCORDANT, ts snapped to the scoreboard
log.why: the board is still 0 at t=120 and t=126 and reads 2 at t=130, so the 2 points land at t~127-129; the frames show them standing at t=120-124 and Rafael on top at t=124-128. The claim is right, its timestamp was ~12s early. Points 2 confirmed on the board.

log.gemini: Guard Pass / Rafael Silverio da Fonseca / pass / true
log.kept_as: Guard Pass / Rafael Silverio da Fonseca / pass / FALSE @ts 180
log.why: t=178/182 show Rafael kneeling INSIDE Bruno's guard, working, with Bruno's legs still between them -- and the scoreboard, which is authoritative for points, awards no 3 until t=290. A completed pass would have scored. So the pass is real and Rafael's, but it did not land: successful flipped to false.

log.gemini: Takedown / Rafael Silverio da Fonseca / takedown / true / points 2

log.gemini: Guard Pass / Rafael Silverio da Fonseca / pass / true / points 3
log.why: board 4 -> 7 between t=288 and t=292, and +3 in this ruleset is the guard pass. Frames at t=286-292 show Rafael consolidating over Bruno.

log.gemini: Knee on Belly / Rafael Silverio da Fonseca / control / true / points 2
log.why: board 7 -> 9 between t=296 and t=300. The frames at t=292-296 read as a top pin whose exact form is not legible, but the board's +2 rules out mount (4) and matches knee-on-belly, which is what was claimed; the points field, not the picture, is what carries this one.
